name: Emma Ytterell - Article 7, après le § 1 - Am 124
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: In exceptional cases, where the nature, complexity, location or size of the proposed project so require, the competent authority may extend the deadlines set out in this paragraph by a period of maximum 30 days. Member States may provide for further extensions in duly justified cases where this is necessary to ensure a comprehensive environmental assessment, taking into account the specific circumstances of the project and national environmental protection requirements.
